text:
mira: quick flash experiment idea: test an inbound routing + credit-drip + prompt-microkit stack for new signups (0-21d).
cal: gist?
mira: gated 20-credit drip: 10 credits on RSVP, 10 on first use. include a 3-prompt microkit sent at RSVP. primary KPI = 7-day activation (first 3 gens).
theo: routing detail: add a short qualify step on RSVP (company size). if >50 or "enterprise interest" -> tag sales:lead and route to SDR.
cal: segment = signups <=21d, generations=0, not on trial. I'll build export.
sam: tracking params to use?
mira: utm_source=inbound_hooks&utm_medium=banner_email&utm_campaign=activation_hooks & route=mk1. put route on banner and RSVP links.
nudge-bot: reminder: workflow "credit_drip_v1" needs approval from @mira before cohort write.
theo: we should AB test two nudge timings: immediate second credit on first-use vs 24h delayed. banner copy also AB: urgent CTA vs helpful CTA.
cal: ok banner AB 50/50 among exposed; control 30% holdback. exporting segment now.
sam: RSVP page: capture hidden route param and user_id to dedupe. will make mock and share link.
mira: prompt microkit = 3 tiny prompts: 1) meeting TL;DR 2) writeup -> product docs tone 3) brainstorm 5 ideas. Keep prompts 2 lines each.
theo: I'll host a 25m office-hours webinar as optional add-on. not gating credits on attendance — credits are RSVP+use-based to reduce no-shows.
cal: dropping csv + banner configs in drive: https://drive.redwood.example/inbound-hooks. check perms.
nudge-bot: calendar event created: "Inbound Activation Hooks sync" Tue May 16 09:00.
sam: analytics: funnel = impressions(route) -> rsvp -> first-use -> 3gen. set alert if first-use < 20% of RSVPs.
mira: owners: cal = segment + banner AB + export; theo = webinar + RSVP mock; sam = analytics + dashboard; mira = prompt kit + credit approval + copy.
cal: will spin up AB tomorrow morning and loop infra for the RSVP form.
theo: RSVP mock at https://rsvp.redwood.example/inbound-hooks (mock).
mira: quick note: avoid calling it "starter" pack in copy. use "microkit". keeps messaging fresh.
sam: adding dedupe by user_id in dashboard. will report early signal within 48h of launch.
mira: sync mon 10am to decide go/no-go. thanks team :sparkles:
